title: Ponta da Piedade Guided Sea Cave Kayak Tour (Beach Launch)
departurePoint: Praia da Batata (next to Forte da Ponta da Bandeira)
highlights: Paddle under the Roman-style arch bridge at Praia dos Estudantes
Enter narrow sea caves: A Catedral, A Cozinha, and Gruta dos Amores
Pass through Arco do Triunfo with a certified local Lagos kayak guide
Snorkeling stop in a sheltered cove near Praia Dona Ana
safetyNotes: Strictly requires wind <= 20 km/h, gusts <= 28 km/h, and Atlantic wave height <= 1.2m. Afternoon 14:00 departures may be cancelled if the Nortada offshore wind picks up.

title: Marina de Lagos Catamaran + Ponta da Piedade Kayak Expedition
highlights: Relaxing 20-minute catamaran cruise from Marina de Lagos to the golden cliffs
Launch kayaks directly at Ponta da Piedade with full safety boat support
Explore A Cozinha, A Sala de Visitas, O Submarino, and A Catedral
Ideal for beginners and families wanting less open-water paddling
safetyNotes: Requires wave height <= 1.2m and wind <= 22 km/h to safely launch kayaks from the mother vessel and enter sea caves.

title: Traditional Fisherman's Grotto Boat Cruise (Costa d'Oiro)
departurePoint: Marina de Lagos or Ponta da Piedade 182-Step Cove
highlights: Navigate inside the Miocene limestone arches aboard a nimble local wooden/fiberglass grotto boat
Learn fishermen's stories behind the 1913 Lighthouse, O Camelo, and A Catedral
No paddling required; great photography angles of the 20m cliffs
safetyNotes: Can operate in slightly breezier conditions than kayaks (up to 28 km/h wind), but cave entry is suspended by Capitania do Porto de Lagos if swell exceeds 1.5m.

title: Passadiços da Ponta da Piedade Cliffside & Lighthouse Guided Walk
departurePoint: Praia Dona Ana Viewpoint -> Farol da Ponta da Piedade
highlights: Walk the elevated wooden boardwalks (Passadiços) safely above the 51m cliffs
Visit the 1913 Ponta da Piedade Lighthouse (site of the 16th-century Ermida)
Spectacular elevated views of dramatic Atlantic waves crashing on O Submarino and Arco do Triunfo
Discover Miocene marine fossils embedded directly in the limestone rocks
safetyNotes: 100% safe during high swells or strong Nortada winds when kayaking is closed. Avoid only during lightning or severe rainstorms.

title: Age of Discoveries Heritage & Dom Rodrigo Gastronomy Walk (Old Town)
departurePoint: Praça Gil Eanes (Historic Center of Lagos)
highlights: Guided entry to Igreja de Santo António (gilded Baroque talha dourada) & Museu de Lagos
Visit Forte da Ponta da Bandeira drawbridge and the 1444 Mercado de Escravos Museum
Hear the story of Gil Eanes rounding Cape Bojador (1434) and Prince Henry's caravels
Tasting of authentic foil-wrapped Dom Rodrigo, Morgado de Amêndoa, and local wine
safetyNotes: All-weather cultural & indoor museum experience; the #1 recommendation when strong winds, heavy Atlantic swell, or rain prevent coastal activities.
